[[File:Yumi.png|thumb|250px|Yumi]]
(Japanese: '''ユミ''' ''Yumi'') is a [[character of the day]] who appeared in ''[[EP052|Princess vs. Princess]]''. 

Yumi participated in the [[Queen of the Princess Festival]] held in [[O-Hina Town]]. In the first round, she was pitted against [[Jessie]]. She sent out {{p|Primeape}} against {{MTR}}, who Jessie had forced to battle for her. Meowth was quickly defeated by Primeape, and Jessie sent out her {{TP|Jessie|Arbok}} next. Primeape was quickly {{status|poison}}ed by Arbok and defeated, much to her horror. Yumi's subsequent three Pokémon were also defeated by Jessie, eliminating her from the tournament.
